name: Eso Es Auto Poster — Buffer via Google Sheets
description: Watches Google Sheets for Approved rows → exports a Buffer-ready row → updates sheet to Scheduled. No Meta API. No Canva API.

metadata.label: Copy row to Buffer staging sheet

variables.GOOGLE_SHEET_ID: REPLACE — your Eso Es Content Schedule sheet ID
variables.BUFFER_STAGING_SHEET_ID: REPLACE — a second sheet used as Buffer staging queue (or same sheet, different tab)

_notes: This blueprint intentionally avoids Meta API and Canva API.
Buffer does not have a native Make.com module for direct scheduling — use the CSV export from the approval page instead.
This blueprint is the upgrade path: sheet status drives the workflow, staging sheet holds the queue, you download and import to Buffer manually.
When Buffer releases a Make.com module, replace step 2 with a direct Buffer:createPost call.
